name: aks-terraform-guide-tools
description: Guide build tools: sync the Terraform code in the md files with the sources, generate the diagrams, and build the single-file HTML guides (English and Korean)

scripts.check: node gen-diagrams.mjs --check && node sync-code.mjs --check && node check-docs.mjs
scripts.build: node gen-diagrams.mjs && node sync-code.mjs && node check-docs.mjs && node build-html.mjs
